scripts.dev:api: mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.foodeza.bookkeeping" && cd api && FOODEZA_DATA_DIR="$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.foodeza.bookkeeping" php artisan serve --host=127.0.0.1 --port=17654
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c red,blue "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n api,desktop -c red,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:desktop"
scripts.setup: cd api && composer install && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan db:seed --force && cd ../desktop && npm install
